answer: Watch who breaks together. Verifiers fire surprise challenges at random moments; a clone farm on one rack stalls, rate-limits and recovers in lockstep, like velvet creasing along one fold. Identities whose failures mirror each other across many unrelated events (assumed: 20+) get merged into one reward seat, the way one blight across an orchard reveals a shared rootstock. Evasion: real separate hardware and schedulers, or injected random dropouts that cost uptime pay. Wrongly hit: honest agents on one cloud during an outage, so only sustained correlation counts, with appeal.
